title: rosa viscaria var. trichocarpa
intro: Rosa viscaria var. trichocarpa, commonly known as the alpine rose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the rose family. The alpine rose has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa viscaria var. trichocarpa include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
